fields.name: Release assistance indication IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for Release assistance indication

fields.name: DDX
fields.description: Downlink data expected. Bits: 00 = No information regarding DDX is conveyed; 01 = No further uplink and no further downlink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected; 10 = Only a single downlink data transmission and no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected; 11 = reserved

notes: The purpose of the Release assistance indication IE is to inform the network whether no further uplink and no further downlink data transmission is expected; or only a single downlink data transmission (e.g. acknowledgement or response to uplink data) and no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected.
The Release assistance indication is a type 1 information element.
Bits 3 and 4 of octet 1 are spare and shall be encoded as zero.
